scope: One-factor radial, energy, angular, and path convergence, a combined higher grid, and a full-grid local collision-kernel order check. The profile, physical channels, fixed-omega B.2 convention, and coupling normalization are held fixed.
title: Global B.13 quadrature convergence audit at 1 MeV
